h1.h1: LangChain vs LlamaIndex: the definitive comparison

hero.hero-sub: Choosing between LangChain and LlamaIndex determines your agent orchestration complexity, retrieval speed, and memory footprint. I build production systems with both, evaluating LangGraph's multi-step agent graphs against LlamaIndex's hierarchical index retrieval for speed and overhead. I pick the right framework or hybrid architecture based on your actual retrieval latency and orchestration needs, not a default toolkit.
